gen-fs-nippo-gf-ubuntu-sans: Nippo's small letters stand nearly as tall as its capitals, cut like bent wire, while Ubuntu Sans fills in with big-eyed, tubular curves. Wire meets copper pipe.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-vend-sans: Nippo hands over a heading of wire-cut strokes, its small letters standing almost capital-sized. Vend Sans follows in a ruler-drawn line with a tall x-height that fills each row.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-yaldevi: Wiry and upright, Nippo draws its lines like bent tubing, with lowercase nearly as tall as capitals. And Yaldevi, a sans-serif with outsized proportions, lets its e open wide to the right.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-hind-siliguri: Hind Siliguri hums along in an unbroken line weight, its rounds slightly gapped and its lowercase standing tall against the capitals. Oswald sits above it, tightly knit and confident.
gen-fs-panchang-clash-grotesk: Clash Grotesk keeps every stroke uniform, with no thick and thin at all. Panchang is best at wide, confident display letters, while the body font does its best work as quiet, steady text.
gen-fs-panchang-fs-asap: Asap's c forms read as open arcs, and its body height nearly matches the capitals. Asap stays sturdy in text, and if Panchang is made small, its wide open spacing loses some of its drama.
gen-fs-panchang-fs-epilogue: Panchang sets confident, expressive letters that never snag on a closed bowl. Epilogue then carries a longer passage with curvy, tall-bodied lowercase and stubby ascenders, its wire-like monoline skeleton keeping the eye moving.
gen-fs-panchang-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans makes words look sturdy and large, its tall lowercase and right-opening e easy on the eye. But Panchang's drawn-string strokes give the pair its strongest quality: a marker-like steadiness throughout.
gen-fs-panchang-fs-supreme: Panchang draws a ruler-straight, constant-width line with open space around every stem and curve. Supreme counters with a heavier, crisp strip of sans-serif text.
gen-fs-panchang-general-sans: Confident and expressive, Panchang opens its curves so nothing snags, while General Sans stays clean with a tall x-height. And the strongest thing here is the smooth, unobstructed path both fonts take around every bend.
